text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race is about to begin, and Kitasan
Black's
phone has been buzzing nonstop
with messages
of support.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I got a message from one of my
classmates!
She said, "I know you'll win it
today, Kita!" ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A lady from the shopping district and my
brother
also sent me a message a while
ago. Everyone's
support means so much
to me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely gonna score a win! Don't
you worry
about a thing and just watch
me whiz past the
finish line!
